pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.2: tena kho pana samayena therā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ovadanti pariyāyena. tena kho pana samayena āyasmato Cūḷapanthakassa pariyāyo hoti bhikkhuniyo ovadituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.3: bhikkhuniyo evam āhaṃsu: na dāni ajja ovādo iddho bhavissati, tañ ñeva dāni udānaṃ ayyo Cūḷapanthako punappunaṃ bhaṇissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.4: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo yenāyasmā Cūḷapanthako ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Cūḷapanthakaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.5: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmā Cūḷapanthako etad avoca: samagga 'ttha bhaginiyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.9: eso bhaginiyo ovādo 'ti niyyādetvā imaṃ udānaṃ punappunaṃ abhāsi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.14: bhikkhuniyo evam āhaṃsu: nanu avocumhā na dāni ajja ovādo iddho bhavissati, tañ ñeva dāni udānaṃ ayyo Cūḷapanthako punappunaṃ bhaṇissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.15: assosi kho āyasmā Cūḷapanthako tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.16: atha kho āyasmā Cūḷapanthako vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā ākāse antalikkhe caṅkamati pi tiṭṭhati pi nisīdati pi seyyam pi kappeti dhūmāyati pi pajjalati pi antarāpi dhāyati tañ ñeva udānaṃ bhaṇati aññañ ca bahuṃ buddhavacanaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.18: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.19: na vata no ito pubbe ovādo evaṃ iddho bhūtapubbo yathā ayyassa Cūḷapanthakassā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.20: atha kho āyasmā Cūḷapanthako tā bhikkhuniyo yāva samandhakārā ovaditvā uyyojesi gacchatha bhaginiyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.21: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo nagaradvāre thakkite bahinagare vasitvā kālass' eva nagaraṃ pavisanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.22: manussā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti: abrahmacāriniyo imā bhikkhuniyo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.23: ārāme bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ vasitvā idāni nagaraṃ pavisantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.24: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.26: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Cūḷapanthako atthaṃgate suriye bhikkhuniyo ovadissatīti --la--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.27: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Cūḷapanthaka atthaṃgate suriye bhikkhuniyo ovadasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.31: n' etaṃ Cūḷapanthaka appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.32: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:1.33.1: sammato ce pi bhikkhu atthaṃgate suriye bhikkhuniyo ovadeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc22:2.1.8: aṭṭhahi vā garudhammehi aññena vā dhammena ovadati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
